title: HTML project: build a structured multi-section website
learningObjectives: Explain html project: build a structured multi-section website and its role in modern HTML.
Select the correct elements, attributes, APIs, or browser behaviour for a practical use case.
Distinguish current practices from obsolete, limited, or legacy techniques.
Build and inspect a working example while considering accessibility and maintainability.
Diagnose common implementation errors and explain the trade-offs of the chosen approach.

understand.concept: A project combines individual HTML skills into a complete document. Plan the information architecture before writing markup: identify the audience, page purpose, navigation, content sections, media, data, and required interactions. Build a valid document with landmarks, descriptive headings, useful links, responsive images, and accessible forms where appropriate. Separate content from presentation by using CSS classes. Validate the finished page, test links and assets, inspect keyboard navigation, and check the result at multiple viewport sizes.
understand.whyItMatters: Knowing isolated elements is not the same as building a coherent page. A project reveals missing structure, broken paths, unclear navigation, inaccessible controls, and inconsistent content.
understand.analogy: A project is like assembling a working house from materials: each component must fit a plan and work with the others.
understand.analogyLimit: A website is not a physical building; browser behaviour, accessibility, content hierarchy, and responsive layout require their own tests.

explain.narrative: Build a small community information website with a header, navigation, main article, service cards, contact details, and footer. Keep the page usable before styling, then progressively add CSS.

practise.guidedTask: Create a multi-section website from a short brief. Include a page title, landmarks, meaningful navigation, at least three content sections, one image with alt text, and a footer. Keep all paths working.
practise.independentTask: Add a responsive CSS layout, an accessible contact form, and a content table only if the data is genuinely tabular. Submit a test report covering keyboard access, link integrity, headings, image alternatives, and mobile layout.
hints: Plan the content hierarchy before choosing elements.
Use relative paths consistently and check letter case in filenames.
Test the page without CSS to verify that the document structure still makes sense.

questions.prompt: What should happen before writing the page markup?
options: Plan the audience, purpose, content structure, and navigation
questions.answer: Plan the audience, purpose, content structure, and navigation
questions.explanation: A clear plan helps select meaningful structure and prevents unnecessary markup.

questions.prompt: Which element should contain the main unique page content?
questions.explanation: The main element identifies the dominant content of the document.

questions.prompt: Why should links use meaningful text?
options: Users can understand the destination from the link text
It removes the need for href
questions.answer: Users can understand the destination from the link text
questions.explanation: Descriptive link text supports scanning and assistive-technology navigation.

questions.prompt: What is a useful final project check?
options: Validate structure and test links, keyboard access, assets, and viewport sizes
Check only the page background colour
Assume the browser fixes every error
questions.answer: Validate structure and test links, keyboard access, assets, and viewport sizes
questions.explanation: A project must be tested for correctness and usability, not just appearance.

questions.prompt: What does progressive enhancement mean in this project?
options: Start with useful semantic HTML and add styling and behaviour in layers
Require JavaScript before any content exists
questions.answer: Start with useful semantic HTML and add styling and behaviour in layers
questions.explanation: The basic content and structure should remain useful before optional enhancements.
